prompt: Composition: Large event title, date and venue, then an unframed program table and direct booking action. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in Bagnard and reading text in Cotham Sans; characterful display serif with understated body. Use Apricot and Cypress: page #FFF9F3, text #293C32, accent #A84218, secondary surface #E4EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 64px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
